chapters.title: Supplications for when you wake up

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: ( الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā, wa ilayhi an-nushūr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: ( لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي ).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.O my Lord forgive me)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharyka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbaru, walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbi ighfr lī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme. O my Lord forgive me

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: ( الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ )
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī fī jasadī, waradda ʿalayya rūḥī, wa adhina ly bi-dhikrih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
duas.text: ( 190 ) Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.( 191 ) Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.( 192 ) Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.( 193 ) Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.( 194 ) Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.( 195 ) And their Lord responded to them, Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward.( 196 ) Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.( 197 ) [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.( 198 ) But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah. And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous.( 199 ) And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah. They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price.Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.( 200 ) O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
duas.transliteration: Inna fī khalqi as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa ikhtilāfi l-layli wa an-nahāri lāyātin lʾūlī l-ʾlbābi alladhīna yadhkurūna llāha qiyāman wa quʿūdan wa ʿalaya junūbihim wa yatafakkarūna fī khalqi as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan subḥānaka fa qinā ʿadhāba an-nāri rabbanā innaka man tudkhili an-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā li-lẓẓālimīna min anṣārin rrabbanā innanā samiʿnā munādīan yunādī li-lʾīmāni an āminū bi-rabbikum fa āmannā rabbanā fa ighfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir ʿannā sayyiʾātinā wa tawaffanā maʿa l-ʾbrāri rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa ʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukhzinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukhlifu l-mīʿāda fa istajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin mminkum mmin dhakarin aw unthā baʿḍukum mmin baʿḍin fa alladhīna hājarū wa ukhrijū min diyārihim wa ūdhū fī sabīlī wa qātalū wa qutilū lʾukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiʾātihim wa lʾudkhilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru thawāban mmin ʿindi llāhi wa-llāhu ʿindahu ḥusnu ath-thawābi lā yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhīna ka-fa rū fī l-bilādi matāʿun qalīlun thumma maʾwāhum jahannamu wa biʾsa l-mihādu lākini alladhīna ttaqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulan mmin ʿindi llāhi wamā ʿinda llāhi khayrun llilʾabrāri waʾinna min ahli l-kitābi laman yuʾminu bi-llāhi wamā unzila ilaykum wamā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna li-llāhi lā yashtarūna bi-āyāti llāhi thamanan qalīlan ūlaʾika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim inna llāha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū iṣbirū wa ṣābirū wa rābiṭū wāttaqū llāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: 190 In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, are signs for people of understanding. 191 They remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and they reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: “Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” 192 “Our Lord, anyone You admit to the Fire is truly disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.” 193 “Our Lord, we heard a caller inviting people to faith: ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we believed. Our Lord, forgive our sins, erase our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous.” 194 “Our Lord, grant us what You promised through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.” 195 Their Lord answered them: “I will never let the work of any of you be lost, whether male or female; you are from one another. I will erase the misdeeds of those who emigrated, were driven from their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought, or were killed, and I will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow—a reward from Allah. With Allah is the finest reward.” 196 Do not be deceived by the freedom with which the disbelievers move through the land. 197 It is only a brief enjoyment; then Hell will be their home—and what a miserable resting place. 198 But those who are mindful of their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain: a welcome from Allah. What is with Allah is better for the righteous. 199 Among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah, in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah and do not trade Allah’s revelations for a small price. Their reward is with their Lord; Allah is swift in reckoning. 200 Believers, be steadfast, outdo one another in steadfastness, remain ready, and be mindful of Allah so that you may succeed.

chapters.title: Invocation when getting dressed

duas.title: Invocation when getting dressed
duas.arabic: (الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...)
duas.text: (All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ka-sānī hādhā ath-thawba wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah...
duas.englishRecitationOnly: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.

chapters.title: Invocation when putting on new clothes

duas.title: Invocation when putting on new clothes
duas.arabic: ( اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ).
duas.text: (O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it (i.e. the garment), I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka l-ḥamdu anta ka-sawtanīhi, asʾaluka min khayrihi wa khayri mā ṣuniʿa lahu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihi washarri mā ṣuniʿa lah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it i.e. the garment, I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.

chapters.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes

duas.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: (تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى)
duas.text: (May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it (with another).’ The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.)
duas.transliteration: Tublī wa yukhlifu llāhu taʿālā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it with another.’

duas.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: (اِلْبَسْ جَدِيداً وَعِشْ حَمِيداً وَمُتْ شَهِيداً).
duas.text: (Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed.)(shaheed:One who dies fighting the kuffar in order to make the word of Allah superior or in defense of Islam. It also has other meanings found in the Sunnah such as: the one who dies defending his life, wealth or family; the woman who passes away due to childbirth; one who drowns…etc.)
duas.transliteration: Al-bas jadīdan waʿish ḥamīdan wamut shahīdā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed.

chapters.title: What to say when undressing

duas.title: What to say when undressing
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah.

chapters.title: Invocation for entering the restroom

duas.title: Invocation for entering the restroom
duas.arabic: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
duas.text: ((In the name of Allah). O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi llāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubthi wa-l-khabʾith
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.

chapters.title: Invocation for leaving the restroom

duas.title: Invocation for leaving the restroom
duas.arabic: (غُفْرَانَكَ).
duas.text: (I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.)
duas.transliteration: Ghufrānak
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I ask You Allah for forgiveness.

chapters.title: What to say before performing ablution

duas.title: What to say before performing ablution
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah.

chapters.title: What to say upon completing ablution

duas.title: What to say upon completing ablution (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..).
duas.text: (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.)
duas.transliteration: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu wa ashhadu anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh..
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

duas.title: What to say upon completing ablution (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ)
duas.text: (O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalnī mina at-tawwābīna wa ijʿalnī mina l-mutaṭahhirīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.

duas.title: What to say upon completing ablution (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: (سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ).
duas.text: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥnaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atwbu ilayk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.

chapters.title: What to say when leaving the home

duas.title: What to say when leaving the home (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, tawakkaltu ʿalā llāhi, walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.title: What to say when leaving the home (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.)(slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an aḍilla, aw uḍalla, aw azilla, aw uzalla, aw aẓlima, aw uẓlama, aw ajhala, aw yujhala ʿalayya
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.

chapters.title: What to say when entering the home

duas.title: What to say when entering the home
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa lajnā, wa bismi llāhi kharajnā, wa ʿalā llāhi rabbinā tawakkalnā, thumma li-yusallim ʿalā ahlih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

chapters.title: Invocation for going to the mosque

duas.title: Invocation for going to the mosque
duas.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوراً، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً، وَعَظِّم لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُوراً، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُوراً، وَفِي دَمِي نُوراً، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُوراً)([اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَبْرِي... وَنُوراً فِي عِظَامِي])[(وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً)][(وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُورٍ)]
duas.text: (‘O Allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. O Allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ [O Allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones]. [And increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light]. [And grant me light upon light.]’)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿal fī qalbī nūran, wa fī li-sānī nūran, wa fī samʿī nūran, wa fī baṣarī nūran, wamin fawqī nūran, wamin taḥtī nūran, waʿan yamīnī nūran, waʿan shimālī nūran, wamin amāmī nūran, wamin khalfī nūran, wa ijʿal fī nafsī nūran, wa aʿẓim lī nūran, wa ʿaẓẓim lī nūran, wa ijʿal lī nūran, wa ijʿalnī nūran, allāhumma aʿṭinī nūran, wa ijʿal fī ʿaṣabī nūran, wa fī laḥmī nūran, wa fī damī nūran, wa fī shaʿrī nūran, wa fī basharī nūran allāhumma ijʿal lī nūran fī qabrī... wa nūran fī ʿiẓāmī wa zidnī nūran, wa zidnī nūran, wa zidnī nūran wahab lī nūran ʿalā nūr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘O Allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. O Allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ [O Allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones]. [And increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light]. [And grant me light upon light.]’

chapters.title: Invocation for entering the mosque

duas.title: Invocation for entering the mosque
duas.arabic: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى) ، وَيَقُولُ: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)) [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ] ((اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ)).
duas.text: (I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi, wa bi-wajhihi l-karīmi, wa sulṭānihi l-qadīmi, mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi bismi llāhi, wa aṣ-ṣalātu wa as-salāmu ʿalā rasūli llāhi llāhumma iftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.guidance: (He begins with his right foot), and says:

chapters.title: Invocation for leaving the mosque

duas.title: Invocation for leaving the mosque
duas.arabic: ((يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى)) وَيَقُولُ: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa aṣ-ṣlātu wa as-salāmu ʿalā rasūli llāhi, allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik, allāhumma iʿṣimnī mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.
duas.guidance: (He begins with his left foot), and says:

chapters.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (1 of 5)
duas.arabic: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلاَّ فِي ((حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَحَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ)) فَيقُولُ: ((لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
duas.text: ‘One repeats just as the mu-aththin (one who calls to prayer) says, except when he says: Hayya 'alas-salah (or) hayya 'alal-falah ‘come to prayer, come to success’ instead, one should say: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah. ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’
duas.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’
duas.guidance: ‘One repeats just as the mu-aththin one who calls to prayer says, except when he says: Hayya ʿAlas-salah or hayya ʿAlal-falah ‘come to prayer, come to success’ instead, one should say:

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (2 of 5)
duas.arabic: يَقُولُ: ((وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً)) ((يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ عَقِبَ تَشَهُّدِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ)).
duas.text: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin, one says:‘And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His salve and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.’
duas.transliteration: Wa anā ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluhu, raḍītu bi-llāhi rabbā, wa bi-muḥammadin rasūlan, wa bi-l-ʾislāmi dīnā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His salve and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.’
duas.guidance: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin, one says:

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (3 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ)).
duas.text: ‘One should then send prayers on the Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) after answering the call of the mu.adhdhin’.
duas.guidance: ‘One should then send prayers on the Prophet sal-Allaahu'alayhe wa sallam after answering the call of the mu. adhdhin’.

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (4 of 5)
duas.arabic: يَقُولُ: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامَاً مَحمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، [إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ])).
duas.text: ‘O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.’al-waseelah: A station in paradise.al-fadeelah: A rank above the rest of creation.praised platform: One in which all of creation will praise him on, in order to bring about the account quickly and be relieved from the lengthy standing or the role of intercession.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba hādhihi ad-daʿwati at-tāmmati, wa aṣ-ṣalāti l-qāʾimati, āti muḥammadan al-wasīlata wa-l-faḍīlata, wa ibʿathhu maqāmā maḥmūdan alladhī wa ʿadtahu, innaka lā tukhlifu l-mīʿād
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.’
duas.guidance: He says:

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (5 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((يَدْعُو لِنَفسِهِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِينَئِذٍ لاَ يُرَدُّ)).
duas.text: One should also supplicate for himself during the time between the athan and the iqamah as supplication at such time is not rejected.
duas.guidance: One should also supplicate for himself during the time between the athan and the iqamah as supplication at such time is not rejected.

chapters.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (1 of 6)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْماءِ وَالْبَرَدِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bāʿid baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bāʿadta bayna l-mashriqi wa-l-maghribi, allāhumma naqqinī min khaṭāyāya kamā yunaqqā ath-thawbu l-ʾabyaḍu mina ad-danasi, allāhumma ighsilny min khaṭāyāya, bi-ath-thalji wa-l-mʾi wa-l-barad
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (2 of 6)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
duas.text: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥnaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, wa tabraka ismuka, wa taʿālā jadduka, walā ilāha ghayruk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (3 of 6)
duas.arabic: ((وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفَاً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلاَتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ المَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبي جَمِيعَاً إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِها إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـــــــدَيْكَ، وَالشَّـــــرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْــــــكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
duas.text: (I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate (others with Allah). Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You.)(Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way. Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)
duas.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhī faṭara as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa ḥanīfā wamā anā mina l-mushrikīna, inna ṣalātī, wa nusukī, wa maḥyāya, wa mamātī li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā sharīka lahu wa bi-dhālika umirtu wa anā mina l-muslimīn. allāhumma anta l-maliku lā ilāha illā anta, anta rabbī wa anā ʿabduka, ẓalamtu nafsī wa iʿtaraftu bi-dhanbī fa ighfir lī dhunūby jamīʿā innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā ant. wa ihdinī li-aḥsani l-ʾakhlqi lā yahdī li-aḥsanih illā anta, wa iṣrif ʿannī sayyiʾahā, lā yaṣrifu ʿannī sayyiʾahā illā anta, labbayka wa saʿdayka, wa-l-khayru kulluhu bi-yadayka, wa ash-sharru laysa ilayka, anā bika wa ilayka, tabrakta wa taʿālayta, astaghfiruka wa atwbu ilayk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate others with Allah. Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You.

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (4 of 6)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ، وَمِيْكَائِيلَ، وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ. اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقيمٍ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel (great angles), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba jibrāʾīla, wa mīkāʾīla, wa isrāfīla, fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn. ihdinī limā ikhtulifa fīhi mina l-ḥaqqi bi-idhnika innaka tahdī man tashāʾu ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqym
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel great angles, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (5 of 6)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً
parts.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yrā
parts.en: Allah is Most Great.

parts.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً
parts.transliteration: Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīrā
parts.en: Much praise is for Allah.

parts.arabic: وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
parts.transliteration: Wa subḥāna llāhi bukratan wa aṣīlā
parts.en: I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon.

parts.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَهَمْزِهِ
parts.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni: min nafkhihi, wa nafthihi, wa hamzih
parts.en: I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.

duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرَاً، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً)) ثَلاثاً ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَهَمْزِهِ)).
duas.text: (Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, and I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon.)(I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.)
duas.transliteration:
Allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yrā
Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīrā
Wa subḥāna llāhi bukratan wa aṣīlā
Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni: min nafkhihi, wa nafthihi, wa hamzih
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
Allah is Most Great.
Much praise is for Allah.
I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon.
I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (6 of 6)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَواتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ] [أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقٌّ، وَالسّاعَةُ حَقٌّ] [اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حاكَمْتُ. فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ] [وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي] [أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ] [أَنْتَ إِلَهِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ] [وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ])).
duas.text: (O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise. You are Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise and the kingdom of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the King of the heavens and the Earth and to You belongs all praise. You are The Truth, Your promise is true, your Word is true, and the Day in which we will encounter You is true, the Garden of Paradise is true and the Fire is true, and the Prophets are true, Muhammad is true and the Final Hour is true. O Allah, unto You I have submitted, and upon You I have relied, and in You I have believed, and to You I have turned in repentance, and over You I have disputed, and to You I have turned for judgment. So forgive me for what has come to pass of my sins and what will come to pass, and what I have hidden and what I have made public. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You, You are my Deity, none has the right to be worshipped except You.)(Meaning of Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir: Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills from amongst His creation just as He defers and holds back whom He wills in accordance to His wisdom. E.g. Favouring man over the rest of creation, favouring the Prophets over the rest of mankind, favouring Muhammad over all the Prophets and Messengers…etc.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka l-ḥamdu, anta nūru as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna, walaka l-ḥamdu anta qayyimu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna, walaka l-ḥamdu anta rabbu as-samawti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna walaka l-ḥamdu laka mulku as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna walaka l-ḥamdu anta maliku as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi walaka l-ḥamdu anta l-ḥaqqu, wa waʿduka l-ḥaqqu, wa qawluka l-ḥaqqu, wa li-qʾuka l-ḥaqqu, wa-l-jannatu ḥaqqun, wa an-nāru ḥaqqun, wa an-nabiyyūna ḥaqqun, wa mḥammadun ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam ḥaqqun, wa as-sʿatu ḥaqqun allāhumma laka aslamtu, wa ʿalayka tawakkaltu, wabika āmantu, wa ilayka anabtu, wabika khṣamtu, wa ilayka ḥkamt. fa ighfir lī mā qaddamtu, wamā akhkhartu, wamā asrartu, wamā aʿlantu anta l-muqaddimu, wa anta l-muʾakhkhiru lā ilāha illā anta anta ilahī lā ilāha illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise. You are Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise and the kingdom of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the King of the heavens and the Earth and to You belongs all praise. You are The Truth, Your promise is true, your Word is true, and the Day in which we will encounter You is true, the Garden of Paradise is true and the Fire is true, and the Prophets are true, Muhammad is true and the Final Hour is true. O Allah, unto You I have submitted, and upon You I have relied, and in You I have believed, and to You I have turned in repentance, and over You I have disputed, and to You I have turned for judgment. So forgive me for what has come to pass of my sins and what will come to pass, and what I have hidden and what I have made public. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You, You are my Deity, none has the right to be worshipped except You.

chapters.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (1 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ)). ثلاث مرَّاتٍ.
duas.text: (How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme.’(three times))
duas.transliteration: Subḥna rabbiya l-ʿaẓīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme.’

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (2 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
duas.text: (How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma rabbanā wa bi-ḥamdika, allāhumma ighfir lī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (3 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((سُبُّوُحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ)).
duas.text: (Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).)
duas.transliteration: Subbuwuḥun, quddūsun, rabbu l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Perfect and Holy He is, Lord of the angles and the Rooh i.e. Jibra-eel.

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (4 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَمُخِّي، وَعَــــظْمِي، وَعَصَبِي، [وَمَا استَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي])).
duas.text: (O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feet carry are humbled before You.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka rakaʿtu, wabika āmantu, walaka aslamtu, khashaʿa laka samʿī, wa baṣarī, wa mukhkhī, wa ʿaẓmī, wa ʿaṣabī, wamā staqallat bihi qadamī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feet carry are humbled before You.

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (5 of 5)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ)).
duas.text: (How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna dhī l-jabarūti, wa-l-malakūti, wa-l-kibriyāʾi, wa-l-ʿaẓamah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.

chapters.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki' (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ)).
duas.text: (May Allah answer he who praises Him.)(This supplication is to be made while rising.)
duas.transliteration: Samiʿa llāhu liman ḥamidah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah answer he who praises Him.

duas.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki' (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ)).
duas.text: (Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.)
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā walaka l-ḥamdu, ḥamdan ka-thyran ṭayyiban mubrakan fīh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.

duas.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki' (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيءٍ بَعْدُ. أَهلَ الثَّناءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ)).
duas.text: (The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said (of You) and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.)(This supplication is made optionally only in conjunction with the previous one.)
duas.transliteration: Milʾa as-samawāti wa milʾa l-ʾarḍi, wamā baynahumā, wa milʾa mā shiʾta min shayʾin baʿd. ahla ath-thanʾi wa-l-majdi, aḥaqqu mā qāla l-ʿabdu, wa kullunā laka ʿabd. allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu
duas.englishRecitationOnly: The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said of You and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty. This supplication is made optionally only in conjunction with the previous one.

chapters.title: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (1 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى)) ثلاث مرَّاتٍ.
duas.text: (How perfect my Lord is, The Most High.’(three times))
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna rabbiya l-ʾaʿlā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect my Lord is, The Most High.’

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (2 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
duas.text: (How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma rabbanā wa bi-ḥamdika, allāhumma ighfir lī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (3 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((سُبوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ)).
duas.text: (Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).)
duas.transliteration: Subwḥun, quddūsun, rabbu l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Perfect and Holy He is, Lord of the angles and the Rooh i.e. Jibra-eel.

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (4 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسنُ الْخَالِقينَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka sajadtu wabika āmantu, walaka aslamtu, sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, wa ṣawwarahu, washaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu, tabāraka llāhu aḥsnu l-khāliqyn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (5 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ)).
duas.text: (How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna dhī l-jabarūti, wa-l-malakūti, wa-l-kibriyāʾi, wa-l-ʿaẓamah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (6 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the seen and hidden of them.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī dhanbī kullahu: diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa ʿalāniyyatahu wa sirrah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the seen and hidden of them.

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (7 of 7)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise, You are as You have praised Yourself.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqwbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise, You are as You have praised Yourself.

chapters.title: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations

duas.title: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
duas.text: (My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.)
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī, rabbi ighfir lī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.

duas.title: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي)).
duas.text: (O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa ijburnī, wa ʿāfinī, wa irzuqnī, wa irfaʿnī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.

chapters.title: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an

duas.title: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، ﴿فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ﴾)).
duas.text: (My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power.<< So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.)
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, washaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu bi-ḥawlihi wa quwwatihi, fa tabraka llāhu aḥsanu l-khāliqīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power.<< So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

duas.title: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْراً، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْراً، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْراً، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration), and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma iktub lī bihā ʿindaka ajran, waḍaʿ ʿannī bihā wizran, wa ijʿalhā lī ʿindaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalhā minnī kamā taqabbaltahā min ʿabdika dāwud
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, record for me a reward for this prostration, and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.

chapters.title: Invocation for At-Tashahhud (sitting in prayer)

duas.title: Invocation for At-Tashahhud (sitting in prayer)
duas.arabic: ((التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَواتُ، وَالطَّيِّباتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسولُهُ)).
duas.text: (At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him. Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you O Prophet. Peace be upon us and all of Allah’s righteous servants. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.)(At-tahiyyat: all words which indicate the glorification of Allah. His eternal existence, His perfection and His sovereignty.)
duas.transliteration: At-taḥiyyātu li-llāhi, wa aṣ-ṣalawtu, wa aṭ-ṭayyibtu, as-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuhā an-nabiyyu wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuhu, as-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādi llāhi aṣ-ṣāliḥīn. ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu wa ashhadu anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa raswluh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him. Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you O Prophet. Peace be upon us and all of Allah’s righteous servants. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

chapters.title: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud

duas.title: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the followers of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibraheem and upon the followers of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. O Allah, send blessings upon Mohammad and upon the family of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon Ibraheem and upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.)(send prayers: praise and exalt him in the highest and superior of gatherings: that of the closest angels to Allah)((al) has been translated in it’s broadest sense: some scholars are of the view that the meaning here is more specific and that it means: his followers from among his family.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin, wa ʿalā āli muḥammadin, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā ibrāhīma, wa ʿalā āli ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdun majīdun, allāhumma bārik ʿalā muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli muḥammadin, kamā bārakta ʿalā ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdun majīd
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the followers of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibraheem and upon the followers of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. O Allah, send blessings upon Mohammad and upon the family of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon Ibraheem and upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.

duas.title: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibraheem, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā āli ibrāhīm. wa bārik ʿalā muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwjihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamā bārakta ʿalā āli ibrāhīm. innaka ḥamīdun majīd
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibraheem, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.

chapters.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء بعد التشهد الأخير قبل السلام

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (1 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُــمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death and from the evil affliction of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal.)(Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will follow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when the Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophethood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, wamin ʿadhābi jahannama, wamin fitnati l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāti, wamin sharri fitnati l-masīḥi ad-dajjāl
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death and from the evil affliction of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (2 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿwdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, wa aʿwdhu bika min fitnati l-masīḥi ad-dajjāli, wa aʿwdhu bika min fitnati l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt. allāhumma innī aʿwdhu bika mina l-maʾthami wa-l-maghram
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (3 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.)(From Yourself: i.e. from Your innermost grace without deserving it and a forgiveness which is befitting to your tremendous generosity.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman ka-thīran, walā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā anta, fa ighfir lī maghfiratan min ʿindika wa irḥamnī, innaka anta l-ghafwru ar-raḥīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (4 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You.)(Meaning of Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir: Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills from amongst His creation just as He defers and holds back whom He wills in accordance to His wisdom. E.g. Favouring man over the rest of creation, favouring the Prophets over the rest of mankind, favouring Muhammad over all the Prophets and Messengers…etc.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī mā qaddamtu, wamā akhkhartu, wamā asrartu, wamā aʿlantu, wamā asraftu, wamā anta aʿlamu bihi minnī. anta l-muqaddimu, wa anta l-muʾakhkhiru lā ilāha illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (5 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبادَتِكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa ḥusni ʿibdatik
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (6 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, I take refuge in You lest I be returned to the worst of lives “i.e. old age, being weak, incapable and in a state of fear”, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of this life and the punishment of the grave.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-bukhli, wa aʿwdhu bika mina l-jubni, wa aʿūdhu bika min an uradda ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnati ad-dunyā wa ʿadhābi l-qabr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, I take refuge in You lest I be returned to the worst of lives “i.e. old age, being weak, incapable and in a state of fear”, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of this life and the punishment of the grave.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (7 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika mina an-nār
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (8 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْــــأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقائِكَ فِي غَيرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger.I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease.I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death.I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bi-ʿilmika l-ghayba wa qudratika ʿalā l-khalqi aḥyinī mā ʿalimta l-ḥayāta khayran lī, wa tawaffanī idhā ʿalimta l-wafāta khayran lī, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khashyataka fī l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati, wa asʾaluka ka-limata l-ḥaqqi fī ar-riḍā wa-l-ghaḍabi, wa asʾaluka l-qaṣda fī l-ghinā wa-l-faqri, wa asʾaluka naʿīman lā yanfadu, wa asʾaluka qurrata ʿaynin lā tanqaṭiʿu, wa asʾaluka ar-riḍā baʿda l-qaḍāʾi, wa asʾaluka barda l-ʿayshi baʿda l-mawti, wa asʾaluka ladhdhata an-naẓari ilā wajhika, wa ash-shawqa ilā li-qʾika fī ghayri ḍarrāʾa muḍirratin, walā fitnatin muḍillatin, allāhumma zayyinā bi-zīnati l-ʾīmāni, wa ijʿalnā hudātan muhtadīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger. I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease. I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death. I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (9 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا أَللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِّيمُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.)(AS-Samad: The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes whom all of creation turn to in all their needs.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka yā llāhu bi-annaka l-wāḥidu l-ʾaḥadu aṣ-ṣamadu alladhī lam yalid walam ywlad, walam yakn lahu kufūan aḥadun, an taghfira lī dhunūbī innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (10 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka biʾanna laka l-ḥamda lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, al-mannānu, yā badīʿa as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrāmi, yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu innī asʾaluka l-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika mina an-nār
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (11 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ)) .
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, The One, AS-Samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him.)(AS-Samad: The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes whom all of creation turn to in all their needs.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-annay ashhadu annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta l-ʾaḥadu aṣ-ṣamadu alladhī lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun lahu kufūan aḥad
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, The One, AS-Samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him.

chapters.title: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (1 of 8)

parts.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
parts.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāh
parts.en: I ask Allah for forgiveness.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma anta as-salāmu, wa minka as-salāmu, tabārakta yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrām
parts.en: O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

duas.arabic: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلاَثَاً) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ)).
duas.text: (I ask Allah for forgiveness.(three times) (O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.) (AS-Salam: The One Who is free from all defects and deficiencies.))
duas.transliteration:
Astaghfiru llāh
Allāhumma anta as-salāmu, wa minka as-salāmu, tabārakta yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrām
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
I ask Allah for forgiveness.
O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (2 of 8)

parts.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
parts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
parts.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu
parts.en: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no wealth or status can benefit its possessor against You.

duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ [ثلاثاً]، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.)
duas.transliteration:
Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.
O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no wealth or status can benefit its possessor against You.

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (3 of 8)
duas.arabic: ((لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ, لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favour, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu, walā naʿbudu illā iyyāhu, lahu an-niʿmatu walahu l-faḍlu walahu ath-thanāʾu l-ḥasanu, lā ilāha illā llāhu mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favour, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it.

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (4 of 8)

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh
parts.en: Glory be to Allah.

parts.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāh
parts.en: All praise is for Allah.

parts.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
parts.transliteration: Wa-llāhu akbar
parts.en: Allah is the Greatest.

parts.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
parts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
parts.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.

duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
duas.text: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest.(thirty-three times) (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.))
duas.transliteration:
Subḥāna llāh
Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāh
Wa-llāhu akbar
Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
Glory be to Allah.
All praise is for Allah.
Allah is the Greatest.
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (5 of 8)
duas.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾،بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ بَعْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.text: The following three Soorahs should be recited once after Zuhr, 'Asr and 'Ishaa prayers and thrice after the Fajr and Maghrib prayers.[Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)] [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] [Soorah an-Naas (114)]
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul huwa llāhu aḥadun allāhu aṣ-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun llahu kufūan aḥadun bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi maliki an-nāsi ilāhi an-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri an-nāsi mina l-jinnati wa an-nās
