duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.
duas.guidance: The following three Soorahs should be recited once after Zuhr,'Asr and'Ishaa prayers and thrice after the Fajr and Maghrib prayers.[Soorah al-Ikhlaas 112 ] [Soorah al-Falaq 113 ] [Soorah an-Naas 114 ]

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (6 of 8)
duas.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾ عَقِبَ كلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.text: It is also from the Sunnah to recite Aayat ul-Kursee after each prayer:[Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255]
duas.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾa wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
duas.guidance: It is also from the Sunnah to recite Aayat ul-Kursee after each prayer: [Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255]

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (7 of 8)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) عَشْرَ مَرّاتٍ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ.
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent.(ten times after the maghrib and fajr prayers))
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa yumītu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent.

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (8 of 8)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) بَعْدَ السّلامِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الفَجْرِ.
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.)(To be said after giving salam for the fajr prayer)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
duas.guidance: To be said after giving salam for the fajr prayer

chapters.title: Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel)

duas.title: Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ {{need}} خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi-ʿilmika, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, wa asʾaluka min faḍlika l-ʿaẓīmi; fa innaka taqdiru walā aqdiru, wa taʿlamu walā aʿlamu, wa anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūbi, allāhumma in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhā l-ʾmra {{need}} khayrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī fa iqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī thmma bārik lī fīhi, waʾin kunta taʿlamu anna hādhā l-ʾamra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī fa iṣrifhu ʿannī wa iṣrifnī ʿanhu wa iqdur liya l-khayra ḥaythu kāna, thumma arḍinī bih
parts.en: ‘O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able while I am not and verily You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this affair {{need}} to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life, and end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me towards my religion, my life, and end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be and make me satisfied with such.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ {{need}} خَيْرٌ لِي فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi-ʿilmika, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, wa asʾaluka min faḍlika l-ʿaẓīmi; fa innaka taqdiru walā aqdiru, wa taʿlamu walā aʿlamu, wa anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūbi, allāhumma in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhā l-ʾmra {{need}} khayrun lī fī ʿājili amrī wa ājilihi fa iqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī thmma bārik lī fīhi, waʾin kunta taʿlamu anna hādhā l-ʾamra sharrun lī fī ʿājili amrī wa ājilihi fa iṣrifhu ʿannī wa iṣrifnī ʿanhu wa iqdur liya l-khayra ḥaythu kāna, thumma arḍinī bih
parts.en: ‘O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able while I am not and verily You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this affair {{need}} to be good for me in relation to the immediate and later consequences of my affair, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me in relation to the immediate and later consequences of my affair, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be and make me satisfied with such.

duas.arabic: قَالَ جَابرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: كَانَ رسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا الْاسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، يَقُولُ: ((إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ - وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ – فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ)).وَمَا نَدِمَ مَنِ اسْتَخَارَ الْخَالِقَ، وَشَاوَرَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَتَثَبَّتَ فِي أَمْرِهِ، فَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّه تعالى: ﴿وَشاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ .
duas.text: (On the authority of Jabir Ibn 'abdullah , he said: ’The Prophet would instruct us to pray for guidance in all of our concerns, just as he would teach us a chapter from the Quran. He would say ’ If any of you intends to undertake a matter then let him pray two supererogatory units (two rak'ah nafilah) of prayer and after which he should supplicate:‘O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able while I am not and verily You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this affair -and here he mentions his need- to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life, and end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me towards my religion, my life, and end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be and make me satisfied with such.)(One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret, for Allah has said:…and consult them in the affair. Then when you have taken a decision, put your trust in Allah…)

chapters.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (1 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected. Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (2 of 24)
duas.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: ([Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)]( 1 ) Say, He is Allah, [who is] One,( 2 ) Allah, the Eternal Refuge.( 3 ) He neither begets nor is born,( 4 ) Nor is there to Him any equivalent.)([Soorah al-Falaq (113)] ( 1 ) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak( 2 ) From the evil of that which He created( 3 ) And from the evil of darkness when it settles( 4 ) And from the evil of the blowers in knots( 5 ) And from the evil of an envier when he envies. )([Soorah an-Naas (114)])( 1 ) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,( 2 ) The Sovereign of mankind.( 3 ) The God of mankind,( 4 ) From the evil of the retreating whisperer -( 5 ) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -( 6 ) From among the jinn and mankind.
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul huwa llāhu aḥadun allāhu aṣ-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun llahu kufūan aḥadun bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi maliki an-nāsi ilāhi an-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri an-nāsi mina l-jinnati wa an-nās
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (3 of 24)

parts.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
parts.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhā l-yawmi wa khayra mā baʿdahu wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhā l-yawmi washarri mā baʿdahu, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sūʾi l-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī an-nāri wa ʿadhābin fī l-qabr
parts.en: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

parts.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
parts.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsā l-mulku li-llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhihi l-laylati wa khayra mā baʿdahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihi l-laylati washarri mā baʿdahā, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sūʾi l-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī an-nāri wa ʿadhābin fī l-qabr
parts.en: We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what follows it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

duas.arabic: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ)). [ وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه] [وإذا أمسى قال: رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها.]
duas.text: ‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allaah, belongs all sovereignty , and all praise is for Allaah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, alone, without any partner, to Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it . My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’
duas.transliteration:
Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhā l-yawmi wa khayra mā baʿdahu wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhā l-yawmi washarri mā baʿdahu, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sūʾi l-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī an-nāri wa ʿadhābin fī l-qabr
Amsaynā wa amsā l-mulku li-llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhihi l-laylati wa khayra mā baʿdahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihi l-laylati washarri mā baʿdahā, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sūʾi l-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī an-nāri wa ʿadhābin fī l-qabr
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what follows it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (4 of 24)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā, wabika amsaynā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa ilayka an-nushūr
parts.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, and by You we enter the evening. By You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā, wabika aṣbaḥnā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa ilayka l-maṣīr
parts.en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning. By You we live and by You we die, and to You is our return.

duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا ، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير.]
duas.text: (O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.)[In the evening:](O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.)
duas.transliteration:
Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā, wabika amsaynā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa ilayka an-nushūr
Allāhumma bika amsaynā, wabika aṣbaḥnā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa ilayka l-maṣīr

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (5 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduka, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā istaṭaʿtu, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿtu, abūʾu laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abūʾu bi-dhanbī fa ighfir lī fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (6 of 24)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa malāʾikatika, wa jamīʿa khalqika, annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk
parts.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning, and I call You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except You alone, without partner, and Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa malāʾikatika, wa jamīʿa khalqika, annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk
parts.en: O Allah, I have entered the evening, and I call You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except You alone, without partner, and Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ)) (أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ).[ وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم إني أمسيت...]
duas.text: (O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angles, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.) (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu) instead of (asbahtu).)
duas.transliteration:
Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa malāʾikatika, wa jamīʿa khalqika, annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk
Allāhumma innī amsaytu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa malāʾikatika, wa jamīʿa khalqika, annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (7 of 24)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka l-ḥamdu walaka ash-shukr
parts.en: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or to any of Your creation this morning is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise, and to You belongs all thanks.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka l-ḥamdu walaka ash-shukr
parts.en: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or to any of Your creation this evening is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise, and to You belongs all thanks.

duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي...]
duas.text: (O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.)(…whoever says this in the morning has indeed offered his day’s thanks and whoever says this in the evening has indeed offered his night’s thanks.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa) instead of (asbaha).)
duas.transliteration:
Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka l-ḥamdu walaka ash-shukr
Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka l-ḥamdu walaka ash-shukr

duas.guidance:

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (8 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You.)(three times) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times))
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-kufri, wa-l-faqri, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, lā ilāha illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (9 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ)) (سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ).
duas.text: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.’ (Recite seven times in Arabic.)
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbiya llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (10 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي)).
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿafwa wa-l-ʿāfiyata fī ad-dunyā wa-l-ʾākhirati, allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿafwa wa-l-ʿāfiyata: fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī, wa mālī, allāhumma istur ʿawrātī, wa āmin rawʿātī, allāhumma iḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya, wamin khalfī, waʿan yamīnī, waʿan shimālī, wamin fawqī, wa aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (11 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkahu, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri ash-shayṭni wa sharakihi, waʾan aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (12 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.’(three times))
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa ismihi shayʾun fī l-ʾarḍi walā fī as-smāʾi wahuwa as-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (13 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad as a Prophet.’(three times))
duas.transliteration: Raḍītu bi-llāhi rabbā, wa bi-l-ʾislāmi dīnan, wa bi-muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam nabīā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad as Prophet.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (14 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ)).
duas.text: (O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.)
duas.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu bi-raḥmatika astaghythu aṣliḥ lī shaʾniya kullahu walā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (15 of 24)

parts.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
parts.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhā l-yawmi: fatḥahu, wa naṣrahu, wa nūrahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudāhu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi washarri mā baʿdah
parts.en: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its success, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.

parts.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ: فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهَا، وَنُورَهَا، وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
parts.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsā l-mulku li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-laylati: fatḥahā, wa naṣrahā, wa nūrahā, wa barakatahā, wa hudāhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhā washarri mā baʿdahā
parts.en: We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its success, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.

duas.arabic: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها.]
duas.text: (We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows:](We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.)
duas.transliteration:
Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhā l-yawmi: fatḥahu, wa naṣrahu, wa nūrahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudāhu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi washarri mā baʿdah
Amsaynā wa amsā l-mulku li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-laylati: fatḥahā, wa naṣrahā, wa nūrahā, wa barakatahā, wa hudāhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhā washarri mā baʿdahā
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its success, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.
We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its success, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (16 of 24)

parts.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
parts.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
parts.en: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.

parts.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
parts.transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
parts.en: We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.

duas.arabic: ((أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام...]
duas.text: (We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)(Note: for the evening, one reads amsayna instead of asbahna.)
duas.transliteration:
Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.
We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (17 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ)) (مائة مرَّةٍ).
duas.text: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.)(one hundred times)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (18 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (عشرَ مرَّات) ، أَوْ (مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.)( [ten times or once if lazy])
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (19 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.)((one hundred times every day))
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (20 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ).
duas.text: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.)(three times)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi: ʿadada khalqihi, wa riḍā nafsihi, wa zinata ʿarshihi, wa midāda ka-li-mātih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (21 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) (إذا أصبحَ).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
duas.guidance: Say this in the morning.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (22 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ)) (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).
duas.text: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’ [one hundred times a day]
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāha wa atūbu ilayh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (23 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أمسى).
duas.text: (I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.)(three times in the evening)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (24 of 24)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ)) (عشرَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’ [ten times]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyinā muḥammad
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’

chapters.title: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (1 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا:بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ)) (يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet would hold his palms together, spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) in them, recite the last three chapters (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) of the Quran and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body, he would do this three times.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul huwa llāhu aḥadun allāhu aṣ-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun llahu kufūan aḥadun bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi maliki an-nāsi ilāhi an-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri an-nāsi mina l-jinnati wa an-nās
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.
duas.guidance: When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet would hold his palms together, spit A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle in them, recite the last three chapters Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas of the Quran and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body, he would do this three times.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (2 of 13)
duas.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (3 of 13)
duas.arabic: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
duas.text: ( 285 ) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination.( 286 ) Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.transliteration: Āmana ar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rrabbihi wa-l-muʾminūna kullun āmana bi-llāhi wa malʾāʾikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin mmin rrusulihi wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilayka l-maṣīru lā yukallifu llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā lahā mā ka-sabat wa ʿalayhā mā iktasabat rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nnasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablinā rabbanā walā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi wa iʿfu ʿannā wa ighfir lanā wa irḥamnā anta mawlānā fānṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: 285 The Messenger believes in what was revealed to him from his Lord, as do the believers. Each believes in Allah, His angels, His scriptures, and His messengers. “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” They say, “We hear and obey. Our Lord, we seek Your forgiveness, and to You is the final return.” 286 Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It receives the good it earns and bears the evil it commits. “Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place upon us a burden like the one You placed upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (4 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ)).
duas.text: (In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.)
duas.transliteration: Bi-ismika rabbī wa ḍaʿtu janbī, wabika arfaʿuhu, faʾin amsakta nafsī frḥamhā, waʾin arsaltahā fa iḥfaẓhā, bimā taḥfaẓu bihi ʿibādaka aṣ-ṣāliḥīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (5 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyhā, in aḥyaytahā fa iḥfaẓhā, waʾin amattahā fa ighfir lahā. allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿāfiyah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (6 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (7 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا)).
duas.text: (In Your name O Allah, I live and die.)
duas.transliteration: Bi-ismika llāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (8 of 13)

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh
parts.en: Glory be to Allah.

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
parts.en: All praise is for Allah.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhu akbar
parts.en: Allah is the Greatest.

duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ))).
duas.text: (How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times) All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times) Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times))
duas.transliteration:
Subḥāna llāh
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
Allāhu akbar
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
Glory be to Allah.
All praise is for Allah.
Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (9 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi warabba l-ʾarḍi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbanā warabba kulli shayʾin, fa-l-qa l-ḥabbi wa an-nawā, wa munzila at-tawrāti wa-l-ʾinjīli, wa-l-furqāni, aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shayʾin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. allāhumma anta l-ʾawwalu fa laysa qablaka shayʾun, wa anta l-ʾākhiru fa laysa baʿdaka shayʾun, wa anta aẓ-ẓāhiru fa laysa fawqaka shayʾun, wa anta l-bāṭinu fa laysa dūnaka shayʾun, iqḍi ʿannā ad-dayna wa aghninā mina l-faqr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock i.e. You have total mastery over. O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You. You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (10 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ)).
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā, wa ka-fānā, wa āwānā, fakam mimman lā kāfiya lahu walā muʾwiy
duas.englishRecitationOnly: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (11 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkahu, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri ash-shayṭni wa shirkihi, waʾan aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (12 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ، وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ)).
duas.text: (The Prophet never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah (chapter 32) and Soorat Al-Mulk (chapter 67).)
duas.guidance: He recites Alif Lām Mīm Tanzīl (Surat as-Sajdah, 32) and Tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mulk (Surat al-Mulk, 67).

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (13 of 13)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You.Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.)(If you then die, you will die upon the fitrah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayka, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayka, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayka, wa aljaʾtu ẓahrī ilayka, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka, lā maljaʾa walā manjā minka illā ilayka, āmantu bi-kitābika alladhī anzalta, wa bi-nabiyyika alladhī arsalt
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.

chapters.title: Invocation to say if you stir in the night

duas.title: Invocation to say if you stir in the night
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar.Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.)(AL-Qahhar:The One Who has subdued all of creation and Whom all of creation are subservient to. All movements occur by His will.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-wāḥidu l-qahhru, rabbu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazyzu l-ghaffār
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar. Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.

chapters.title: What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء الفزع في النوم و من بُلِيَ بالوحشة

duas.title: What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ)).
duas.text: (I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābihi, washarri ʿibādihi, wamin hamazāti ash-shayṭīni waʾan yaḥḍurūn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.

chapters.title: What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare
chapters.titleArabic: ما يفعل من رأى الرؤيا أو الحلم

duas.title: What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: [ (يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثلاثاً)) - (يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ)) - ((لاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَداً)) - ((يَــتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ)) ]
duas.text: [((Spit on your left three times)(Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle)) - (Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw (Three Times)) - (Do not relate it to anyone) - (Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously.) - (Get up and pray if you so desire.) ]
duas.guidance: [ Spit on your left three times Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle - Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw Three Times - Do not relate it to anyone - Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously. - Get up and pray if you so desire. ]

duas.title: What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ)).
duas.text: (Get up and pray if you so desire.)
duas.guidance: Get up and pray if you so desire.

chapters.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You.For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.)(Evil you have decreed: Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way.Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ihdinī fīman hadayta, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayta, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayta, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayta, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayta; fa innaka taqḍī walā yuqḍā ʿalayka, innahu lā yadhillu man wa-l-yta, walā yaʿizzu man ʿādayta tabrakta rabban wa taʿālayt
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You. For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُــــوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers.O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You.We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma iyyāka nʿbudu, walaka nuṣallī wa nasjudu, wa ilayka nasʿā wa naḥfidu, narjū raḥmataka, wa nakhshā ʿadhābaka, inna ʿadhābaka bi-l-kāfirīna mulḥaq. allāhumma innā nastaʿynuka, wa nastaghfiruka, wa nuthnī ʿalayka l-khayra, walā nakfuruka, wa nuʾminu bika, wa nakhḍaʿu laka, wa nakhlaʿu man yakfruk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You. We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.

chapters.title: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

duas.title: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ
parts.transliteration: Subḥāna l-maliki l-quddūs
parts.en: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.

parts.arabic: رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
parts.transliteration: Rabbi l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
parts.en: Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ)) ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ والثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ: [رَبِّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ])).
duas.text: (How perfect The King, The Holy One is.(three times) on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).))
duas.transliteration:
Subḥāna l-maliki l-quddūs
Rabbi l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.
Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
duas.guidance: On the third repetition, raise and prolong your voice, then add:

chapters.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief

duas.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ʿabduka, ibnu ʿabdika, ibnu amatika, nāṣiyatī bi-yadika, māḍin fīa ḥukmuka, ʿadlun fīa qaḍāʾuka, asʾaluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fī kitābika, aw ʿallamtahu aḥadan min khalqika, awi istaʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmi l-ghaybi ʿindaka, an tajʿala l-qurʾāna rabīʿa qalbī, wa nūra ṣadrī, wa jalāʾa ḥuznī, wa dhahāba hammī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand i.e. You have total mastery over, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.

duas.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

chapters.title: Invocations for anguish

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-ʿaẓīmu l-ḥalīmu, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu as-samawāti warabbu l-ʾarḍi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū, falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿaynin, wa aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullahu, lā ilāha illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina aẓ-ẓlimīn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً)).
duas.text: (Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.)
