duas.transliteration: Allāhu llāhu rabbī lā ushriku bihi shayʾā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

chapters.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان

duas.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.

duas.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta ʿaḍudī, wa anta naṣīrī, bika aḥūlu wabika aṣūlu, wabika uqtil
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.

duas.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ)).
duas.text: (Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).)
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbun allāhu wa niʿma l-wakīl
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee He is.

chapters.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers

duas.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.text: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rbba as-samawāti as-sabʿi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, kun lī jāran min fulāni bni fulānin, wa aḥzābihi min khalāʾiqika, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, ʿazza jāruka, wajalla thanāʾuka, walā ilāha illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.

duas.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic)
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu aʿazzu min khalqihi jamīʿan, allāhu aʿazzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdharu, aʿūdhu bi-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-mumsiki as-samawāti as-sabʿi an yaqaʿna ʿalā l-ʾarḍi illā bi-idhnihi, min sharri ʿabdika fulānin, wa junūdihi wa atbāʿihi wa ashyāʿihi, min al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi, allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanāʾuka waʿazza jāruka, wa tabāraka ismuka, walā ilāha ghayruk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.

chapters.title: Invocation against an enemy

duas.title: Invocation against an enemy
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma munzila l-kitābi, sarīʿa l-ḥisābi, ihzimi l-ʾaḥzāba, allāhumma hzimhum wa zalzilhum
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.

chapters.title: What to say if you fear people may harm you

duas.title: What to say if you fear people may harm you
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ikfinīhim bimā shiʾt
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.

chapters.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان

duas.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ و يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ)).
duas.text: (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)
duas.guidance: Say: I seek refuge in Allah. Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.

duas.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((يَقُولُ: ((آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ)).
duas.text: (He should say: (I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.))
duas.transliteration: Āmantu bi-llāhi wa rusulih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.
duas.guidance: He should say:

duas.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾)).
duas.text: (He should also recite the following verse: (He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.)(ththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.))
duas.transliteration: Huwa l-ʾwwalu wa-l-ʾākhiru wa aẓ-ẓhiru wa-l-bṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has full knowledge of everything.
duas.guidance: He should also recite the following verse:

chapters.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt

duas.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ikfinī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmika, wa aghninī bi-faḍliki ʿamman siwāk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.

duas.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

chapters.title: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء الوسوسة في الصلاة و القراءة

duas.title: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً))).
duas.text: (othman Ibn Al-'as narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) on your left side three times.)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.guidance:
othman Ibn Al-ʿAs narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle on your left side
and spit lightly to your left.

chapters.title: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you

duas.title: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً)).
duas.text: (O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlan, wa anta tajʿalu l-ḥazna idhā shiʾta sahlā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.

chapters.title: What to say and do if you commit a sin
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول ويفعل من أذنب ذنبا

duas.title: What to say and do if you commit a sin
duas.arabic: ((مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ)).
duas.text: (Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rak'as) and then seeks Allah’s forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.)
duas.guidance: Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer i.e. two rakʿas and then seeks Allah’s forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.

chapters.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings

duas.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ)).
duas.text: Seeking refuge from him.
duas.guidance: Seeking refuge from him.

duas.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((الْأَذَانُ)).
duas.text: The Adhaan [call to prayer].
duas.guidance: The Adhaan [call to prayer].

duas.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ)).
duas.text: (Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.)(e.g. ‘Do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat Al-Baqarah has been read’ related by Muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat Al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat Al-Baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)
duas.guidance: Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.

chapters.title: Invocation when something you dislike happens, or when you fail in what you attempt
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء حينما يقع ما لا يرضاه أو ُ غلب على أمره

duas.title: Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do
duas.arabic: ((قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ)).
duas.text: (Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.)(for verily ‘If’ lets in the work of the devil.)
duas.transliteration: Qadaru llāhu wamā shāʾa faʿal
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

chapters.title: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

duas.title: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

parts.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
parts.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka fī l-mawhūbi laka, wa shakarta l-wāhiba, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah
parts.en: May Allah bless the child granted to you, enable you to thank the Giver, allow the child to reach maturity, and bless you with the child’s dutifulness.

parts.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
parts.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jazāka llāhu khayran, wa razaqaka llāhu mithlahu, wa ajzala thawābak
parts.en: May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, reward you with goodness, grant you a similar blessing, and make your reward abundant.

duas.arabic: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ)). وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَــــــنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ)).
duas.text: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
duas.transliteration:
Bāraka llāhu laka fī l-mawhūbi laka, wa shakarta l-wāhiba, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah
Bāraka llāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jazāka llāhu khayran, wa razaqaka llāhu mithlahu, wa ajzala thawābak
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
May Allah bless the child granted to you, enable you to thank the Giver, allow the child to reach maturity, and bless you with the child’s dutifulness.
May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, reward you with goodness, grant you a similar blessing, and make your reward abundant.
duas.guidance: The parent replies:

chapters.title: How to seek Allah's protection for children

duas.title: How to seek Allah's protection for children
duas.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما ((أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ)).
duas.text: (Ibn 'abbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.))
duas.transliteration: Uʿīdhukumā bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin, wamin kulli ʿaynin lāmmah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.
duas.guidance: Ibn ʿAbbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:

chapters.title: Invocations for visiting the sick

duas.title: Invocations for visiting the sick (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.text: (Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.)
duas.transliteration: Lā bʾsa ṭahūrun in shāʾa llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Never mind, may it the sickness be a purification, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Invocations for visiting the sick (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ)) (سبع مرات).
duas.text: (I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person) will be cured.))
duas.transliteration: Asʾalu llāha l-ʿaẓyma rabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi an yashfyak
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’. 7times he the sick person will be cured.

chapters.title: The reward for visiting the sick

duas.title: The reward for visiting the sick
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ)).
duas.text: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.)
duas.guidance:
Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say:
‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.

chapters.title: Invocations of the terminally ill
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته

duas.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى)).
duas.text: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa alḥiqnī bi-ar-rafīqi l-ʾaʿlā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions

duas.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ)).
duas.text: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu inna lilmawti sakarāt
duas.englishRecitationOnly: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
duas.guidance: 'Aa.ishah radhi-yAllaahu'anhaa related that The Prophet sal-Allaahu'alayhe wa sallam [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:

duas.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu wa-llāhu akbaru, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, lā ilāha illā llāhu walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

chapters.title: What to encourage the dying person to say

duas.title: What to encourage the dying person to say
duas.arabic: ((مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ)).
duas.text: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.) will enter Paradise.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.
duas.guidance:
He whose last words are:
will enter Paradise.

chapters.title: Invocation when tragedy strikes

duas.title: Invocation for when tragedy strikes
duas.arabic: ((إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا)).
duas.text: (To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return.O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.)
duas.transliteration: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūna, allāhumma jurnī fī muṣībatī, wa akhlif lī khayrā minhā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

chapters.title: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead

duas.title: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ (بِاسْمِهِ) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir li-{{deceasedName}} wa irfaʿ darajatahu fī l-mahdiyyīna, wa ikhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fī l-ghābirīna, wa ighfir lanā walahu yā rabba l-ʿālamīna, wa ifsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fīh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive {{deceasedName}} and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.

chapters.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ])).
duas.text: (O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu, wa ʿāfihi, wa iʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, wa ighsilhu bi-l-māʾi wa ath-thalji wa-l-baradi, wa naqqihi mina l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta ath-thawba l-ʾabyaḍa mina ad-danasi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjā khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhu l-jannata, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabri wa ʿadhābi an-nār
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir li-ḥayyinā wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa ka-byrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi ʿalā l-ʾislāmi, waman tawaffaytahu minnā fa tawaffahu ʿalā l-ʾīmāni, allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrahu, walā tuḍillanā baʿdah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma inna fulāna bna fulānin fī dhimmatika, wa ḥabli jiwārika, faqihi min fitnati l-qabri, wa ʿadhābi an-nāri, wa anta ahlu l-wafāʾi wa-l-ḥaqqi, fa ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿabduka wa ibnu amatika iḥtāja ilā raḥmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun ʿan ʿadhābihi, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātihi, waʾin kāna musīʾan fa tajāwaz ʿanh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.

chapters.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (1 of 2)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabr
parts.en: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalhu fa raṭan wa dhukhran li-wa ad-dayhi, wa shafīʿan mujāban, allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā, wa aʿẓim bihi ujwrahumā, wa alḥiqhu bi-ṣāliḥi l-muʾminīna, wa ijʿalhu fī ka-fa-l-ti ibrāhīma, waqihi bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, allāhumma ighfir li-aslāfinā, wa afrāṭinā, waman sabaqanā bi-l-ʾīmān
parts.en: O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and increase their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell. Grant him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.

duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ)) وإن قال: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ)) إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ.
duas.text: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave . [it is also good to say] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
duas.transliteration:
Allāhumma aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabr
Allāhumma ijʿalhu fa raṭan wa dhukhran li-wa ad-dayhi, wa shafīʿan mujāban, allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā, wa aʿẓim bihi ujwrahumā, wa alḥiqhu bi-ṣāliḥi l-muʾminīna, wa ijʿalhu fī ka-fa-l-ti ibrāhīma, waqihi bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, allāhumma ighfir li-aslāfinā, wa afrāṭinā, waman sabaqanā bi-l-ʾīmān
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.
O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and increase their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell. Grant him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.
duas.guidance:
Or say:
This is also good.

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً)).
duas.text: (O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalhu lanā fa raṭan, wa salafan, wa ajrā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward

chapters.title: Invocation for the bereaved

duas.title: Invocation for the bereaved

parts.arabic: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
parts.transliteration: Inna li-llāhi mā akhadha, walahu mā aʿṭā, wakullu shayʾin ʿindahu bi-ajalin musammā... faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib
parts.en: Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given. Everything with Him has an appointed term. So let her be patient and seek Allah’s reward.

parts.arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
parts.transliteration: Aʿẓama llāhu ajraka, wa aḥsana ʿazāʾaka, wa ghafara li-mayyitik
parts.en: May Allah increase your reward, comfort you in your bereavement, and forgive your deceased.

duas.arabic: ((إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ)). وَإِنْ قَالَ: ((أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ)) فَحَسَنٌ.
duas.text: (Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time…and then he ordered for her to be patient and hope for Allah’s reward.)(The words (faltasbir waltahtasib) are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)
duas.transliteration:
Inna li-llāhi mā akhadha, walahu mā aʿṭā, wakullu shayʾin ʿindahu bi-ajalin musammā... faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib
Aʿẓama llāhu ajraka, wa aḥsana ʿazāʾaka, wa ghafara li-mayyitik
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given. Everything with Him has an appointed term. So let her be patient and seek Allah’s reward.
May Allah increase your reward, comfort you in your bereavement, and forgive your deceased.
duas.guidance:
The final two Arabic verbs address a woman. Adjust their forms for the person being addressed.
Or say:
This is also good.

chapters.title: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave

duas.title: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ)).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa ʿalā sunnati rasūli llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

chapters.title: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead

duas.title: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ)).
duas.text: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lahu, allāhumma thabbith
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him

chapters.title: Invocation for visiting the graves

duas.title: Invocation for visiting the graves
duas.arabic: ((السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ)).
duas.text: (Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you.)
duas.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla ad-diyāri, mina l-muʾminīna wa-l-muslimīna, wa innā in shāʾa llāhu bikum lāḥiqūna, wa yarḥamu llāhu l-mustaqdimīna minnā wa-l-mustʾkhirīna asʾalu llāha lanā wa lakumu l-ʿāfiyah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you. [And may Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone before and those who come later.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and you.

chapters.title: Invocations for when the wind blows

duas.title: Invocations for when the wind blows (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْــــــأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.

duas.title: Invocations for when the wind blows (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bihi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā fīhā, washarri mā ursilat bih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.

chapters.title: Invocation for when it thunders

duas.title: Invocation for when it thunders
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ)).
duas.text: (How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna alladhī yusabbiḥu ar-raʿdu bi-ḥamdihi wa-l-malāʾiktu min khīfatih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect He is, The One Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.

chapters.title: Some invocations for rain

duas.title: Some invocations for rain (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma isqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿan, nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārrin, ʿājilan ghayra ājil
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.

duas.title: Some invocations for rain (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا)).
duas.text: (O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.

duas.title: Some invocations for rain (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma isqi ʿibādaka, wa bahāʾimaka, wa inshur raḥmataka, wa aḥyī baladaka l-mayyit
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.

chapters.title: Invocation for when it rains

duas.title: Invocation for when it rains
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً)).
duas.text: (O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.

chapters.title: Supplication after it rains

duas.title: Supplication after it rains
duas.arabic: ((مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ)).
duas.text: (We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Muṭirnā bi-faḍli llāhi wa raḥmatih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

chapters.title: Invocation for the withholding of the rain

duas.title: Invocation for the withholding of the rain
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā walā ʿalaynā, allāhumma ʿalā l-ʾākāmi wa aẓ-ẓirābi, wa buṭūni l-ʾawdiyati, wa manābiti ash-shajar
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, let it fall on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.

chapters.title: Invocation for sighting the new moon

duas.title: Invocation for sighting the new moon
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.text: (Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhumma ahillahu ʿalaynā bi-l-ʾamni wa-l-ʾīmāni, wa as-salāmati wa-l-ʾislāmi, wa at-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu rabbanā wa tarḍā, rabbunā wa rabbuka llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

chapters.title: Invocations for breaking the fast

duas.title: Invocations for breaking the fast (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.text: (The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.)
duas.transliteration: Dhahaba aẓ-ẓamaʾu wa ibtallati l-ʿurūqu, wa thabata l-ʾajru in shāʾa llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Invocations for breaking the fast (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-raḥmatika allatī wa siʿat kulla shayʾin an taghfira lī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.

chapters.title: Invocations before eating

duas.title: Invocations before eating (1 of 2)

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Bismi llāh
parts.en: In the name of Allah.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
parts.transliteration: Bismi llāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih
parts.en: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.

duas.arabic: ((إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)).
duas.text: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end.)
duas.transliteration:
Bismi llāh
Bismi llāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
In the name of Allah.
In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
duas.guidance:
Before eating, say:
If you forgot at the beginning, say:

duas.title: Invocations before eating (2 of 2)

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh
parts.en: O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with food better than it.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh
parts.en: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

duas.arabic: ((مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ)).
duas.text: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(O Allah, bless it for usand give us more of it.))
duas.transliteration:
Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh
Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with food better than it.
O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.
duas.guidance:
When Allah provides you with food, say:
When Allah gives you milk to drink, say:

chapters.title: Invocations after eating

duas.title: Invocations after eating (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ)).
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi, min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.

duas.title: Invocations after eating (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا)).
duas.text: (Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.)(There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ḥamdan ka-thīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīhi, ghayra makfiyyin walā muwaddaʿin, walā mustaghnayan ʿanhu rabbanā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord. There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.

chapters.title: A dinner guest's invocation for his host

duas.title: A dinner guest's invocation for his host
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, wa ighfir lahum wa irḥamhum
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you
chapters.titleArabic: التعريض بالدعاء لطلب الطعام أو الشراب

duas.title: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي)).
duas.text: (O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭʿim man aṭʿamanī, wa isqi man saqānī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.

chapters.title: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت

duas.title: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them
duas.arabic: ((أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ)).
duas.text: (May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.)
duas.transliteration: Afṭara ʿindakumu aṣ-ṣāʾimūna, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumu l-ʾabrāru, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumu l-malāʾikah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who offers you food when you are fasting, which you decline
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر

duas.title: Invocation for someone who offers you food when you are fasting, which you decline
duas.arabic: ((إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ)) ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
duas.text: (If you are invited (to a meal) then answer. If you happen to be fasting, then supplicate (for those present) and if you are not fasting, then eat.)
duas.guidance: If you are invited to a meal, accept the invitation. If you are fasting, supplicate for the host; if you are not fasting, eat.

chapters.title: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول الصائم إذا سابه أحد

duas.title: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you
duas.arabic: ((إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ)).
duas.text: (I am fasting, I am fasting.)
duas.transliteration: Innī ṣāʾimun, innī ṣāʾim
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I am fasting, I am fasting.

chapters.title: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season

duas.title: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا)).
duas.text: (O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our sa' for us and bless our mudd for us.)(A sa' is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man’s two palms.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī thamarinā, wa bārik lanā fī madīnatinā, wa bārik lanā fī ṣāʿinā, wa bārik lanā fī muddinā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saʿ for us and bless our mudd for us.

chapters.title: Invocation for sneezing

duas.title: Invocation for sneezing

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
parts.en: All praise is for Allah.

parts.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
parts.transliteration: Yarḥamuka llāh
parts.en: May Allah have mercy on you.

parts.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
parts.transliteration: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
parts.en: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

duas.arabic: ((إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
duas.text: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.))
duas.transliteration:
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
Yarḥamuka llāh
Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
All praise is for Allah.
May Allah have mercy on you.
May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.
duas.guidance:
When you sneeze, say:
A companion should reply:
The sneezer should then reply:

chapters.title: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقال للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله

duas.title: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah
duas.arabic: ((يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
duas.text: (May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.)
duas.transliteration: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

chapters.title: Invocation for the groom

duas.title: Invocation for the groom
duas.arabic: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ)).
duas.text: (May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.)
duas.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka, wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah bless for you your spouse and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.

chapters.title: The groom's supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

duas.title: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal
duas.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ)).
duas.text: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayhi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.
duas.guidance:
when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:
and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.

chapters.title: Invocation to be recited before intercourse

duas.title: Invocation to be recited before intercourse
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا)).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, allāhumma jannibnā ash-shayṭāna, wa jannibi ash-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.

chapters.title: Invocation for anger

duas.title: Invocation for anger
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
duas.text: (I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

chapters.title: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune

duas.title: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً)).
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.)
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī mimmā ibtalāka bihi, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā ka-thīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.

chapters.title: What to say while sitting in an assembly

duas.title: What to say while sitting in an assembly
duas.arabic: ((عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)).
duas.text: (Ibn 'umar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.))
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī, watub ʿalayya, innaka anta at-tawwābu l-ghafūr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me to accept my repentance. Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.
duas.guidance: Ibn ʿUmar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up:

chapters.title: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis

duas.title: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
duas.text: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك

duas.title: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you
duas.text: ('abdullah Ibn Sarjis said: ‘I went to see the Prophet and ate from his food and then said to him: (May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.) he replied: (and you.))
duas.transliteration: Walak
duas.englishRecitationOnly: and you.
duas.guidance: ʿAbdullah Ibn Sarjis said: ‘I went to see the Prophet and ate from his food and then said to him: May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah. he replied:

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who does good to you

duas.title: Invocation for someone who does good to you
duas.arabic: ((جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً)).
duas.text: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
duas.transliteration: Jazāka llāhu khayrā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah reward you with goodness.
duas.guidance:
If someone does you a favour and you say:
then you have indeed excelled in praising him.

chapters.title: Invocation for Allah's protection from the False Messiah
chapters.titleArabic: ما يعصم الله به من الدجال

duas.title: Invocation for Allah's protection from the False Messiah
duas.arabic: ((مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ)) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.text: (Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will folow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)(Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.)(One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(Refer to supplications #55 & #56))
duas.guidance: Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal. One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who tells you: I love you for the sake of Allah
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله

duas.title: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah
duas.arabic: ((أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ)).
duas.text: (May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.)
duas.transliteration: Aḥabbaka alladhī aḥbabtanī lah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth

duas.title: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth
duas.arabic: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ)).
duas.text: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.)
duas.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.

chapters.title: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money

duas.title: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money
duas.arabic: ((بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ)).
duas.text: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.)
duas.transliteration: Braka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālika, innamā jazāʾu as-salafi l-ḥamdu wa-l-ʾadāʾ
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.

chapters.title: Invocation for fear of Shirk

duas.title: Invocation for fear of Shirk
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ)).
duas.text: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā aʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka limā lā aʿlam
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك

duas.title: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you
duas.arabic: ((وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.text: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back (from distributing it), 'aishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (May Allah bless you all.) 'aishah would then say: (and may Allah bless them.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)
duas.transliteration: Wa fīka bāraka llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: and may Allah bless them.
duas.guidance: Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back from distributing it, ʿAishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: May Allah bless you all. ʿAishah would then say:

chapters.title: Invocation against evil portent

duas.title: Invocation against evil portent
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
duas.text: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruka, walā khayra illā khayruka, walā ilāha ghayruk
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

chapters.title: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal

duas.title: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥānaka llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa ighfir lī; fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā ant
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this transport at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.

chapters.title: Invocation for traveling

duas.title: Invocation for traveling

parts.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
parts.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
parts.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
parts.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.

parts.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
parts.transliteration: Āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbinā ḥāmidūn
parts.en: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ))، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: ((آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ)).
duas.text: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is, The One Who has placed this (transport) at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. O Allah, we ask You for birr and taqwa in this journey of ours, and we ask You for deeds which please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover it’s distance quickly. O Allah, You are The Companion on the journey and The Successor over the family, O Allah, I take refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a change of hearts and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill fated outcome with wealth and family.)(birr and taqwa: two comprehensive terms which individually, refer to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions. When combined together, birr refers to doing those actions which have been commanded and taqwa refers to avoiding those actions which have been prohibited.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.))
duas.transliteration:
Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
