duas.guidance: When returning, recite the travel supplication again and add:

chapters.title: Invocation for entering a town or city

duas.title: Invocation for entering a town or city
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi wamā aẓlalna, warabba l-ʾaraḍīna as-sabʿi wamā aqlalna, warabba ash-shayṭīni wamā aḍlalna, warabba ar-riyāḥi wamā dharayna, asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-qaryati, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri ahlihā, washarri mā fīhā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.

chapters.title: Invocation for entering a market

duas.title: Invocation for entering a market
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wahuwa ḥayyun lʾi yamūtu, bi-yadihi l-khayru, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.

chapters.title: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail

duas.title: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail
duas.text: (In the name of Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah.

chapters.title: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind

duas.title: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind
duas.arabic: ((أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ)).
duas.text: (I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.)
duas.transliteration: Astawdiʿukumu llāha alladhī lā taḍīʿu wa dāʾiʿuh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

chapters.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler

duas.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: (( أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ)).
duas.text: (I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Astawdiʿu llāha dīnaka, wa amānataka, wa khawātīma ʿamalik
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

duas.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ)).
duas.text: (May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.)(taqwa: a comprehensive term which refers to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions.)
duas.transliteration: Zawwadaka llāhu at-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara laka l-khayra ḥaythu m kunt
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

chapters.title: Glorifying and magnifying Allah on the journey
chapters.titleArabic: التكبير و التسبيح في سير السفر

duas.title: Glorifying and magnifying Allah on the journey
duas.arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه: ((كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)).
duas.text: Jabir said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu 'Akber (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah (Glory is to Allah)
duas.guidance:
Jabir said:
Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu'Akber Allah is the Most Great and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah Glory is to Allah

chapters.title: The traveler's invocation at dawn

duas.title: The traveler's invocation at dawn
duas.arabic: ((سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
duas.text: (May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.)
duas.transliteration: Sammaʿa sāmiʿun bi-ḥamdi llāhi, wa ḥusni balāʾihi ʿalaynā, rabbanā ṣḥibnā, wa afḍil ʿalaynā, ʿāʾidhan bi-llāhi mina an-nār
duas.englishRecitationOnly: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.

chapters.title: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء إذا نزل منزلاً في سفر أو غيره

duas.title: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)).
duas.text: (I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.

chapters.title: What to say upon returning from a journey

duas.title: What to say upon returning from a Journey
duas.arabic: ((يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ)).
duas.text: (Ibn 'umar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.))
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbin ḥāmidūna, ṣadaqa llāhu waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzba waḥdah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.
duas.guidance: Ibn ʿUmar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. and then he would say:

chapters.title: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول من أتاه أمر يسره أو يكرهه

duas.title: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
parts.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī bi-niʿmatihi tatimmu aṣ-ṣāliḥāt
parts.en: All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
parts.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl
parts.en: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.

duas.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ)) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)).
duas.text: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
duas.transliteration:
Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī bi-niʿmatihi tatimmu aṣ-ṣāliḥāt
Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.
All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
duas.guidance:
When something pleased the Prophet, he would say:
When something displeased him, he would say:

chapters.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet (PBUH)
chapters.titleArabic: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (1 of 5)
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً)).
duas.text: (The Prophet (PBUH) said: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.)
duas.guidance:
The Prophet PBUH said:
‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (2 of 5)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)).
duas.text: (He (PBUH) also said: ‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.)
duas.guidance:
He PBUH also said:
‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (3 of 5)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)).
duas.text: (He (PBUH) also said: ‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.)
duas.guidance:
He PBUH also said:
‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (4 of 5)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:((إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ)).
duas.text: The Prophet [PBUH] said:'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my 'Ummah (nation).
duas.guidance:
The Prophet [PBUH] said:
'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings or prayers of peace of my'Ummah nation.

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (5 of 5)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ)).
duas.text: The Prophet [PBUH] said: 'No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings
duas.guidance:
The Prophet [PBUH] said:
'No one sends greetings or prayers of peace upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings

chapters.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)

duas.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ)).
duas.text: (The Messenger of Allah said: ‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.)
duas.guidance:
The Messenger of Allah said:
‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.

duas.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ((ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ)).
duas.text: (Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.)
duas.guidance: Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend charitably out of the little you have.

duas.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ: ((تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ)).
duas.text: (Aabdullah Ibn Aamr reported that a man asked the Prophet : ‘Which Islam is the best?’. He replied: Feed (the poor), and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.)
duas.guidance:
Aabdullah Ibn Aamr reported that a man asked the Prophet: ‘Which Islam is the best?’. He replied:
Feed the poor, and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.

chapters.title: How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you
chapters.titleArabic: كيف يرد السلام على الكافر إذا سلم

duas.title: How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you
duas.arabic: ((إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ)).
duas.text: (When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying: (And upon you.))
duas.transliteration: Wa ʿalaykum
duas.englishRecitationOnly: And upon you.
duas.guidance: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying:

chapters.title: Invocation upon hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey
chapters.titleArabic: الدُّعاءُ عِنْدَ سَمَاعِ صِياحِ الدِّيكِ ونَهِيقِ الْحِمَارِ

duas.title: Invocation upon hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey
duas.arabic: ((إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً)).
duas.text: (If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.)
duas.guidance: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.

chapters.title: Invocation upon hearing a dog barking in the night

duas.title: Invocation upon hearing a dog barking in the night
duas.arabic: ((إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ)).
duas.text: (If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.)
duas.guidance: If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.

chapters.title: Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to

duas.title: Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma fa ayyumā muʾminin sababtuhu fa ijʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma l-qiyāmah
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.
duas.guidance: The Prophet PBUH said:

chapters.title: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول المسلم إذا مدح المسلم

duas.title: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا)).
duas.text: (He said: ‘If anyone of you is impelled to praise his brother, then he should say: ‘I deem so-and-so to be…and Allah is his reckoner…and I don’t praise anyone, putting it (i.e. my praising) forward, in front of Allah’s commendation, however I assume him so and so’…if he knows that of him.)
duas.transliteration: Aḥsibu fulānan wa-llāhu ḥasībuhu, walā uzakkī ʿalā llāhi aḥadā
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I consider so-and-so [to be…], and Allah is his Reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah.
duas.guidance:
He said: If anyone of you is compelled to praise his companion, then he should say:
If he knows those qualities of him, he may add: I consider him to be such-and-such.

chapters.title: What a Muslim should say when he is praised

duas.title: What a Muslim should say when he is praised
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ])).
duas.text: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tuʾākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūna, wa ighfir lī mā lā yaʿlamūna, wa ijʿalnī khayran mimmā yaẓẓunnūn
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].

chapters.title: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah
chapters.titleArabic: كيف يلبي المحرم في الحج أو العمرة ؟

duas.title: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah
duas.arabic: ((لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ)).
duas.text: (Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.)
duas.transliteration: Labbayka llāhumma labbayka, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayka, inna l-ḥamda, wa an-niʿmata, laka wa-l-mulka, lā sharīka lak
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Here I am O Allah, in response to Your call, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

chapters.title: Saying Allahu Akbar when passing the Black Stone

duas.title: Saying Allahu Akbar when passing the Black Stone
duas.arabic: ((طَافَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ)).
duas.text: (The Prophet circled the Ka'bah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: (Allah is the greatest))
duas.guidance: The Prophet circled the Kaʿbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: Allah is the greatest

chapters.title: Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone
chapters.titleArabic: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود

duas.title: Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone
duas.arabic: ((﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ﴾)).
duas.text: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: (O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.)
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī l-ʾākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāba an-nār
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Our Lord, give us what is good in this world and what is good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.guidance: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone:

chapters.title: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

duas.title: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

parts.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
parts.transliteration: Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih
parts.en: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.

parts.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
parts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, allāhu akbar
parts.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

parts.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
parts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, anjaza waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzāba waḥdah
parts.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.

duas.arabic: لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ)) فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذلكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ)) الْحَدِيثُ. وَفِيهِ: ((فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)).
duas.text: (Jabir said when describing the Prophet’s pilgrimage: ‘…and when he approached mount Safa he recited: (Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah…) (I begin with what Allah began with.) so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the Ka'bah, he then faced it and said: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things amnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.)) (he would repeat this action at Marwah.)
duas.transliteration:
Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih
Lā ilāha illā llāhu, allāhu akbar
Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, anjaza waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzāba waḥdah
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.
duas.guidance:
When the Prophet approached Ṣafā, he recited:
He climbed Ṣafā until he could see the Kaʿbah, faced the qiblah, and proclaimed Allah’s oneness and greatness:
He then said:
Then make a personal supplication between each recitation.
He made a personal supplication between repetitions and repeated the remembrance three times. At Marwah, he repeated the same sequence of remembrance and personal supplication.

chapters.title: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat

duas.title: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
duas.text: (The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of 'arafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is): (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.))
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.guidance: The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of ʿArafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said is:

chapters.title: Supplication to be recited at the sacred area of Muzdalifah

duas.title: Supplication to be recited at the sacred area of Muzdalifah
duas.arabic: رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
duas.text: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash aril Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great), Allaahu Ahad (Allah is One) and Laa ilaaha illallaah (There is none worthy of worship but Allah). He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.
duas.guidance: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area Al-Mash aril Haraam. Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar Allah is the Most Great, Allaahu Ahad Allah is One and Laa ilaaha illallaah There is none worthy of worship but Allah. He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.

chapters.title: Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina
chapters.titleArabic: التكبير عند رمي الجمار مع كل حصاة

duas.title: Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina
duas.arabic: ((يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا)).
duas.text: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu 'Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
duas.guidance: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu'Akbar Allah is the Most Great with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after stoning the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it for supplications.

chapters.title: What to say when surprised or startled

duas.title: What to say when surprised or startled (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ!)).
duas.text: (How perfect Allah is.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh!
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is.

duas.title: What to say when surprised or startled (2 of 2)
duas.text: (Allah is the greatest.)
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbar!
duas.englishRecitationOnly: Allah is the greatest.

chapters.title: What to say when something that pleases you happens
chapters.titleArabic: ما يفعل من أتاه أمر يسره

duas.title: What to say when something that pleases you happens
duas.arabic: ((كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى)).
duas.text: (The Prophet PBUH would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure. )
duas.guidance: The Prophet PBUH would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure.

chapters.title: What to say when you feel a pain in your body
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول من أحس وجعا في جسده

duas.title: What to say when you feel a pain in your body

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Bismi llāh
parts.en: In the name of Allah.

parts.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
parts.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir
parts.en: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.

duas.arabic: ((ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ)).
duas.text: (Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: (In the name of Allah(three times)) the supplicate seven times: (I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.))
duas.transliteration:
Bismi llāh
Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
In the name of Allah.
I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.
duas.guidance: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say:

chapters.title: What to say when you fear you may afflict something with the evil eye
chapters.titleArabic: دعاء من خشي أن يصيب شيئا بعينه

duas.title: What to say when you fear you may afflict something with the evil eye
duas.arabic: ((إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ)).
duas.text: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.
duas.guidance: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.

chapters.title: What to say when you feel frightened

duas.title: What to say when you feel frightened
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!)).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh!
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

chapters.title: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول عند الذبح أو النحر

duas.title: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي)).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.)
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa-llāhu akbaru llāhumma minka walaka llāhumma taqabbal minnī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, it is from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.

chapters.title: What to say to foil the devil's plots
chapters.titleArabic: ما يقول لرد كيد مردة الشياطين

duas.title: What to say to foil the devil's plots
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ)).
duas.text: (I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. (I take refuge) from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. (I take refuge) from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.)
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bkalimāti llāhi at-tāmmāti allatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun walā fājirun: min sharri mā khalaqa, wa baraʾa wa dharaʾa, wamin sharri mā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi, wamin sharri mā yaʿruju fyhā, wamin sharri mā dharaʾa fī l-ʾarḍi, wamin sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wamin sharri fitani l-layli wa an-nahāri, wamin sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bi-khayrin yā raḥmān
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. I take refuge from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. I take refuge from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.

chapters.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (1 of 6)
duas.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ)).
duas.text: (The Messenger of Allah said: ‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.)
duas.guidance:
The Messenger of Allah said:
‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (2 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
duas.text: (He also said: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.)
duas.guidance:
He also said:
‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (3 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ)).
duas.text: (He also said: ‘Whoever says:(I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.) Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.)
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāha l-ʿaẓyma alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayywumu wa atūbu ilayh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.
duas.guidance:
He also said: ‘Whoever says:
Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (4 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ)).
duas.text: (He said: ‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.)
duas.guidance:
He said:
‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (5 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ)).
duas.text: (He also said: ‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.)
duas.guidance:
He also said:
‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (6 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
duas.text: (He also said: ‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.)(preoccupied: i.e. in a state of ‘forgetfulness’. The Prophet always used to increase in his remembrance of his Lord, in attaining a nearness to Allah and having consciousness of Allah to the extent that if this intensity lessened in anyway, he would regard it as a sin and would then race to seek forgiveness from Allah.)
duas.guidance:
He also said:
‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.

chapters.title: The excellence of remembering Allah
chapters.titleArabic: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (1 of 12)
duas.arabic: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر)).
duas.text: (Whoever says:(How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
duas.guidance:
Whoever says:
a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (2 of 12)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ)).
duas.text: (Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.)
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.englishRecitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.guidance:
Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says:
Ten times; this is like freeing four persons from the descendants of Ishmael.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (3 of 12)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ)).
duas.text: (Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’(There are) Two words, (which are ) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.))
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi, subḥna llāhi l-ʿaẓīm
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.
duas.guidance: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’ There are Two words, which are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious:

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (4 of 12)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لَأَنْ أَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ)).
duas.text: (Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying: (How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.) is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbar
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.
duas.guidance:
Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying:
is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (5 of 12)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ)) فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: ((يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ)).
duas.text: (Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: (How perfect Allah is.) one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.)
duas.guidance:
Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, and he said:
‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him: How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: How perfect Allah is. one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (6 of 12)
duas.arabic: ((مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ)).
duas.text: (Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says: (How perfect Allah is . The Supreme, and I praise Him.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi wa bi-ḥamdih
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him.
duas.guidance:
Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says:
a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (7 of 12)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ))؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ((قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
duas.text: ('abdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘'abdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say: (There is no might nor power except with Allah.))
duas.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.guidance: ʿAbdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘ʿAbdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say:

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (8 of 12)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأتَ)).
duas.text: (the most beloved words to Allah are four: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.))(it does not matter which of them you start with.)
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbar
duas.englishRecitationOnly: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.
duas.guidance:
the most beloved words to Allah are four:
it does not matter which of them you start with.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (9 of 12)

parts.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
parts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yran, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīran, subḥāna llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
parts.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
parts.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa irzuqnī
parts.en: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.

duas.arabic: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: ((قُلْ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ)) قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: ((قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي)).
duas.text: (Sa'd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He replied: ‘Say:(O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.))
duas.transliteration:
Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yran, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīran, subḥāna llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa irzuqnī
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.
duas.guidance:
A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah and said, ‘Teach me words to say.’ He replied:
The man then said, ‘These are for my Lord, but what is for me?’ He replied:

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (10 of 12)
duas.arabic: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)).
duas.text: (Tariq Al-Ashja'ee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: (O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.))
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfiri lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa ʿāfinī wa irzuqnī
duas.englishRecitationOnly: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.
duas.guidance: Tariq Al-Ashjaʿee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words:

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (11 of 12)

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
parts.en: All praise is for Allah.

parts.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
parts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh
parts.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.

duas.arabic: ((إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)).
duas.text: (Jabir Ibn ‘'abdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Verily, the best supplication is: (All praise is for Allah.) and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.))
duas.transliteration:
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
Lā ilāha illā llāh
duas.englishRecitationOnly:
All praise is for Allah.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
duas.guidance:
The best supplication is:
And the best remembrance is:

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (12 of 12)
duas.arabic: الباقيات الصالحات : سبحان الله والحمد لله ، ولا إله إلا الله ،والله أكبر ،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
duas.text: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is Allah', and 'The praise is for Allah', and 'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and 'Allah is the Most Great', and 'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
duas.transliteration: Sbḥn allāh wlḥmd li-llāh wl ilāh l allāh wllh kbr w l ḥwl wl qwh l bllh
duas.englishRecitationOnly: 'Glorified is Allah', and'The praise is for Allah', and'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and'Allah is the Most Great', and'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
duas.guidance: The good deeds which endure are

chapters.title: How the Prophet glorified Allah

duas.title: How the Prophet glorified Allah
duas.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنه قَالَ: ((رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ)) وفي زيادةٍ: ((بِيَمِينِهِ)).
duas.text: (Tasbeeh, it means here, to say: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) ('abdullah Ibn 'amr said: ’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh with his right hand.)
duas.guidance:
ʿAbdullah Ibn ʿAmr said:
’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh
with his right hand.

chapters.title: Types of goodness and good etiquette for community life

duas.title: Types of goodness and good etiquette for community life
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ((إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَـكُفُّوا صِبْيانَـكُم، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ)).
duas.text: When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour (i.e. the first hour) of the night, (you may) let them (the children) go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps. Peace and blessing be upon our Prophet, Muhammad, and upon his family and his Companions, all of them.
duas.guidance:
The Prophet PBUH said:
When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour i.e. the first hour of the night, you may let them the children go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps.
